Eric Weinstein's episode 1203 of the Joe Rogan Experience is an early entry in his long run of visits. Weinstein, a mathematician and investor, was then introducing his grand physics theory and his critique of timid science to wide audiences. Rogan's studio became his loudest platform.

He argues that universities reward safe work and exile bold minds, and he sketches the unified theory he says he was discouraged from publishing. Rogan asks him to slow down and translate. The episode is the starting gun for one of the show's defining guest arcs, full of the confidence and grievance that mark all his later talks.
